Package proguard.util

Interface ProcessableVisitor

All Superinterfaces:
AttributeVisitor, ClassVisitor, ConstantVisitor, KotlinModuleVisitor, MemberVisitor, ResourceFileVisitor
All Known Implementing Classes:
AllProcessableVisitor, ProcessingFlagCleaner, ProcessingFlagSetter
public interface ProcessableVisitor extends ClassVisitor, MemberVisitor, AttributeVisitor, ResourceFileVisitor, ConstantVisitor
This interface defines visitor methods for the main Processable implementations.

      Description copied from interface: ResourceFileVisitor
